user.title: IQAir account
user.description: Email and password are used to read your purifiers. Controlling them also needs the session cookie of a signed-in IQAir dashboard; you can add it now or later with Reconfigure.

data_description.password: Your IQAir password. If you normally sign in with Google, set a password on your IQAir account first.
data_description.session: Sign in at dashboard.iqair.com, open the browser's developer tools, and copy the Cookie request header of any request to dashboard.iqair.com. You can paste the whole header; only the `session` cookie is kept.

reauth_confirm.title: IQAir needs new credentials
reauth_confirm.description: IQAir stopped accepting the stored password or dashboard session for {email}. Fill in the one that changed and leave the other empty.

data_description.password: Only needed if you changed your IQAir password.
data_description.session: Sign in at dashboard.iqair.com, open the browser's developer tools, and copy the Cookie request header of any request to dashboard.iqair.com.

reconfigure.title: IQAir credentials
reconfigure.description: Update the password or the dashboard session for {email}. Leave a field empty to keep what is stored.

data_description.session: Sign in at dashboard.iqair.com, open the browser's developer tools, and copy the Cookie request header of any request to dashboard.iqair.com.

error.invalid_auth: IQAir did not accept this email and password.
error.wrong_account: That password belongs to a different IQAir account than the one configured.
error.invalid_session: IQAir did not accept this session cookie. Copy it again from a browser that is signed in to dashboard.iqair.com.
error.nothing_entered: Enter a password or a session cookie.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach IQAir. Try again in a few minutes.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This IQAir account is already configured.

control_not_configured.message: Controlling IQAir purifiers needs a dashboard session cookie. Add one with Reconfigure on the IQAir Cloud integration.

session_expired.message: IQAir no longer accepts the dashboard session. Enter a new session cookie to control the purifier.

command_failed.message: The command did not reach IQAir: {reason}
